parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' inside the 'Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/' directory tree, which is a canonical sample-app location. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record sits under Examples/ or SampleApp/ must be treated as a sample-app-mirror and no refactor action should be taken. The canonical definition in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift' (package: DebugPanel) is the production type; the WallpaperSampleApp copy is a local convenience alias for demonstration purposes and coupling it to the production package would contaminate production semantics with sample-app concerns.
